host_initiated_findings.finding: round 1 promoted the indefinite 'a cloak' to the proper item name 欺诈斗篷
host_initiated_findings.ground: the reviewer passed this revision as OK, so it is host-initiated. The referent is genuine and the corpus name is correct, but the English is deliberately indefinite and the speaker is a stranger bargaining with a newly risen undead who has never seen the item, so naming it discloses a proper noun he does not utter. This is the b26 shape; the b27 refinement does not rescue it because there the item name was used on a branch actually gated on ROD_OF_RECALL, whereas nothing here gates on the cloak - the player kills him and loots it
host_initiated_findings.resolution: item name reverted to a generic 斗篷; round 1's other improvements to the same string were kept
